items.source: Uses of DecoratingClassLoader in org.springframework.core
items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.core` 包中 `DecoratingClassLoader` 的用法

items.source: Uses of DecoratingClassLoader in org.springframework.instrument.classloading
items.translation: `org.springframework.instrument.classloading` 中 `DecoratingClassLoader` 的用法

items.source: ClassLoader that does not always delegate to the parent loader as normal class loaders do.
items.translation: 不总是像普通类加载器那样委托给父加载器的`ClassLoader`。
可插拔的 ClassLoader 的简单实现。

items.source:
Provides basic classes for exception handling and version detection,
and other core helpers that are not specific to any part of the framework.
items.translation: 提供用于异常处理和版本检测的基础类，以及其他不针对框架任何特定部分的辅助核心工具。

items.source:
Support package for load time weaving based on class loaders,
as required by JPA providers (but not JPA-specific).
items.translation: 基于类加载器的支持包，用于在运行时进行织入（load time weaving），这是 JPA 提供者所必需的（但不特定于 JPA）。

items.source:
Subclass of ShadowingClassLoader that overrides attempts to
locate certain files.
items.translation: ShadowingClassLoader 的子类，覆盖了对某些文件定位的尝试。

items.source:
ClassLoader decorator that shadows an enclosing ClassLoader,
applying registered transformers to all affected classes.
items.translation: 用于遮蔽外围 ClassLoader 的 ClassLoader 装饰器，将已注册的转换器应用于所有受影响的类。

items.source:
ClassLoader that can be used to load classes without bringing them
into the parent loader.
items.translation: 可用于加载类而无需将其引入父加载器的 ClassLoader。
